name: Frauenthal Holding AG
summary: Frauenthal Holding AG engages in the wholesale of plumbing, heating, and electrical supplies through showrooms, cash and carry stores, and online in Austria and internationally. It operates through Frauenthal Automotive and Frauenthal Trade segments. The company distributes pipeline and valve systems for civil engineering and industry; and bathroom solutions, including ceramics, taps, mirrors, and furniture. It also engages in the renovation of bathrooms; commissioning and maintenance of air conditioning systems and heat pumps; sale of heat pumps and storage products; and installation and sale of photovoltaic systems.
